name: No 333 Frisco PM 2021

venue.name: [Warren Sports Complex](https://www.friscotexas.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Warren-Sports-Complex-77)
venue.details: A community pavilion inside Warren Sports Complex

information:
**This competition is a twin competition with No 3x3x3 Frisco AM 2021.  You may only register for one (either AM or PM) of the two competitions.**

**This competition will be following unique precautions to protect competitors and spectators against COVID-19.  By registering, you automatically consent to COVID restrictions. Please check COVID Safety tab for further details.**

If COVID cases rise, we may need to cancel this competition; competitors will be notified by email in that case.

The venue is a pavilion inside Warren Sports Complex.  **Spectators and Guests will not be allowed in the pavilion. Only competitors for the competition will be allowed under it. We recommend that guests and participants bring a fold up chair if possible. We can sit around the pavilion to make room for the competition and competitors wishing to use the extra tables. This will also help with social distancing**.
